referenceFunction.generalComment: The dataset consists of figures of the Itaipu hydropower station complemented with European data. The lifetime is assumed to be 150 years for the dams and 80 years for the rest of the materials. The data set describes a mix and is therefore not representative for individual plants. This dataset recalculated based on Itaipu Binacional, Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Vattenfall (2008).; UUID: 3f6b6953-77b6-3309-809c-0fef6fa3f3fa
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset includes the most important materials used for the construction of an average hydropower reservoir in Brazil and its disposal/recycling. Furthermore, transports and energy used for the construction as well as particle emissions due to the construction activities are included.
referenceFunction.name: Reservoir hydropower plant

technology.text: The data is not representative for individual reservoir hydropower stations. Capacity: 95MW
